不再害怕
又大又响的东西
When Fuzzy Was Afraid of Big and Loud Things
[英] 芭芭拉·迈尔 (Barbara Meier) 著
[英] 詹妮弗·坎顿 (Jennifer Cordon) 绘
孙燕 译
美国心理学会
American Psychological Association
官方授权
APA
北京联合出版公司

[P2] 不再害怕又大又响的东西
When Fuzzy Was Afraid of
Big and Loud Things
[美] 英格·迈尔（Inger Maier） 著
[美] 詹妮弗·坎顿（Jennifer Candon） 绘
孙燕 译

化学工业出版社
·北京·

[P3] 小羊富丝和他的爸爸妈妈住在农场，
农场里还有其他的动物。
他喜欢和朋友们一起玩，在花丛中找
蝴蝶。
他喜欢看鸭子和青蛙在小池塘里扑腾，
看小猪在旁边的泥地里打滚。
他还喜欢听周围的声音：嘎嘎、呱呱、
哼哼、咩咩。

[P4] 可是富丝害怕一些东西。
他害怕一切又大又响的东西。
当他听到农场拖拉机的“突突”声时，
他会吓得发抖。
当他看到大奶牛和听到大奶牛洪亮的
“哞哞”声时，他会藏到石头后面。
当他听到公鸡“喔喔喔”的声音时，
他会把耳朵堵起来，拼命地跑到爸爸或妈妈的身边。

[P5] 最让富丝害怕的是雷声。
每天他会观察天上是不是有会下暴风雨的云。
要是他看见远方的闪电，听到雷声，他就会藏到妈妈的肚子下面。
一个晴天，爸爸对富丝说：“我们去大苹果树那边转一转吧。”
富丝担心地皱了皱眉头，爸爸注意到了这一点。爸爸想起来，在很久以前，当他自己也是一只毛茸茸的小羊时，他也害怕一些东西，不过后来他学会了在不用害怕的时候就不害怕。爸爸想帮帮富丝。
“我们可能会看到一些大的东西，听到一些响的声音，也许你会害怕。”爸爸说，“记住，妈妈和我会一直保护你的安全。”

[P6] 爸爸和富丝跟着嗡嗡叫的蜜蜂，来到铺满蒲公英的草地上。
他们深深地吸了一口气，把蒲公英绒球吹到空中去。
富丝感到内心很平静。
他喜欢和爸爸在一起，虽然爸爸个子很大。

[P7] 富丝的朋友乌鸦在旁边喳喳叫，
“这个大声音是友好的。”富丝咩咩地说道。

公鸡在旁边扇动翅膀，发出“喔喔喔”的尖叫声。
“我怕！”富丝轻声说，“他生气了吗？”“没有，”爸爸温和地说，“深吸一口气，和我一起唱——”

“他是只大鸟，他和乌鸦一个样，都是大嗓门，他不会伤害我，哦，不，他不会伤害我。”

富丝开始唱歌，连乌鸦也跟着一起唱。
多么响的声音！

[P8] 过了一会儿，他们看见大奶牛吃着草，发出响亮的哗哗声，和苹果树旁的大白羊打招呼。
富丝的小心脏跳得又快又猛烈。“不！我不要到那边去！”他说。
“看那些苹果，我们过去吃吧。”爸爸轻声说，他慢慢地走到树旁，和那些大动物们在一起。富丝很想跑回家，但他留下了，他轻轻地对自己讲爸爸说过的话。
“爸爸会保护我的安全！”
“看那些美味的苹果！”
“我喜欢苹果，我马上就要吃到苹果了。”

[P9] 当富丝走近时，他看到大奶牛有温和的眼睛。
他还注意到大奶牛和大白羊友好地说哈罗。
“大奶牛和大白羊很友好，”他想，“虽然他们个子很大。”
过了一会儿，富丝觉得胆子足够大了，可以去找大红苹果了。

富丝甚至还对大白羊说他感觉很害怕。
大白羊试了试各种声音：“咩——咩！啊——啊！
叭——啦！富丝，我很高兴你告诉我这些，不过我不能
改变我的声音和个头儿。”
大白羊尝试发出小一点声音的样子太好玩了，富丝笑了又笑，这下他觉得更安心了。

[P10] 回家的路上，富丝看见大红拖拉机。“哎呀！糟糕！”富丝说。
“听它的突突突的声音，”爸爸说，“拖拉机把土地耕好，农夫就好种玉米了。”
“有一些好吃的玉米是给我们吃的，对吗？”富丝连蹦带跳地说，“我知道了！拖拉机发出的声音是好声音。如果我不认为那是坏声音，我就不会害怕了。”
“还有，”爸爸补充说，“如果你出去玩，玩了一会儿你甚至注意不到这些声音了。”

[P11] “我不喜欢牧羊犬那么响的叫声，”富丝说，
“我该认为那也是友好的声音吗？”
“我也不喜欢它们的汪汪声，”爸爸说，“但我对自己说，这只特别的狗发出这么响的声音，是为了让我们羊群安全地待在一起。”
富丝试着给那些声音起不那么吓人的名字，
想出好的意思。
“拖拉机的突突声让我们有晚餐吃。”
“牧羊犬的汪汪声让我们安全。”
“大白羊发出叫声是友好地打招呼。”
让他惊讶的是，他甚至开始喜欢一些很响的声音了。

[P12] 但是富丝还是害怕打雷和闪电。
“我们会尽力保护你的安全，”妈妈说，“所以我们会告诉你，当外面闪电和打雷的时候，不要跑到苹果树下面，也不要在河里玩水。记住，富丝，”妈妈补充说，“如果没有雨，我们就不会有绿草地，不会有花，也不会有大红苹果了。”

一天下午，爸爸听到远处传来熟悉的轰鸣声，他有了一个帮助富丝的好主意。
“到地里来。”爸爸说，“云朵羊过来了！它们要到天空中粉色和灰色的云城堡去开音乐会！”

[P13] 大云朵越来越近了，不时还有黄色的闪电照亮天空。
“看！灰色的大毛羊乐队上台了。小号吹着爵士乐，羊鼓手敲出了梆梆——咚咚——锵的声音。”
富丝紧贴着爸爸。
“我想我看到了大羊号。”富丝说。
“是的！”爸爸笑着说，“看，闪电照亮了舞台，这样我们就能看到乐队了。”
暴风雨的声音和图像一点一点地在富丝的头脑中变得友好了。他不再需要躲避雷电和乌云，因为那是大羊乐队的大音乐会。

[P14] 富丝还是觉得有一些害怕，不过他学会去倾听那些声音了。
他的朋友和乐队一起唱，“咩——咩”“哼——哼”“嘎——嘎”“呱——呱”。公鸡和乌鸦在一起唱，“喔——喔——喔”，还有“喳——喳——喳”。
苹果树的枝条和叶子快乐地拍手，在风中呼啸。
多么响的声音！

[P15] “太好玩了！”富丝笑着说，拍着手和爸爸一起咩咩叫。
哇，他也发出了一个很大、很响的声音！

[P2] No Longer Afraid of Big and Loud Things
When Fuzzy Was Afraid of
Big and Loud Things
[US] Inger Maier (Inger Maier) Author
[US] Jennifer Candon (Jennifer Candon) Illustrator
Translated by Sun Yan

Chemical Industry Press
·Beijing·

[P3] Little sheep Fusi and his爸爸妈妈 live on a farm,
There are other animals on the farm too.
He likes to play with his friends, looking for
butterflies in the flowers.
He likes to watch ducks and frogs splashing in the small pond,
and pigs rolling in the muddy ground nearby.
He also likes to listen to the sounds around: quack, croak,
Oink, baa.

[P4] But Fuzzy was afraid of some things.
He was afraid of everything big and loud.
When he heard the farm tractor's 'putt-putt' sound,
he would tremble with fear.
When he saw the big cow and heard the big cow's loud
'moo-moo' sound, he would hide behind a rock.
When he heard the rooster's 'cock-a-doodle-doo' sound,
he would cover his ears and run desperately to his dad or mom's side.

[P5] What scared Fuss the most was thunder.
Every day, he would watch the sky to see if there were clouds that might bring a storm.
If he saw lightning in the distance or heard thunder, he would hide under Mommy’s belly.
On a sunny day, Daddy said to Fuss, “Let’s go take a walk over to the big apple tree.”
Fuss frowned worriedly, and Daddy noticed. Daddy remembered that, long ago, when he was a fluffy little lamb himself, he was afraid of some things too. But later, he learned not to be afraid when there was no need to be. Daddy wanted to help Fuss.
“We might see some big things and hear some loud sounds, and maybe you’ll be scared,” Daddy said. “Remember, Mommy and I will always protect your safety.”

[P6] Dad and Fuzzy followed the buzzing bees to a meadow covered in dandelions.
They took a deep breath and blew the dandelion fluff into the air.
Fuzzy felt calm inside.
He liked being with Dad, even though Dad was very big.

[P7] Fus's friend the crow chirped beside him,
"This loud sound is friendly," Fus bleated.

The rooster flapped his wings beside him, making a "cock-a-doodle-doo" sound.
"I'm scared!" Fus whispered, "Is he angry?" "No," Dad said gently, "Take a deep breath and sing with me—"

"He's a big bird, just like the crow, he's got a loud voice, he won't hurt me, oh no, he won't hurt me."

Fus began to sing, and even the crow joined in.
What a loud sound!

[P8] After a while, they saw the big cow eating grass, making loud chewing sounds, and greeting the big white sheep by the apple tree.
Fus's little heart beat fast and fiercely. "No! I don't want to go over there!" he said.
"Look at those apples, let's go eat them," Dad whispered softly. He slowly walked to the tree and stood with the big animals. Fus really wanted to run home, but he stayed. He quietly told himself what Dad had said.
"Dad will protect my safety!"
"Look at those delicious apples!"
"I like apples, I'm going to eat them right away!"

[P9] When Fusi approached, he saw that the big cow had gentle eyes.
He also noticed that the big cow and the big white sheep were saying hello kindly.
"The big cow and the big white sheep are friendly," he thought, "even though they are very big."
After a while, Fusi felt brave enough to go look for the big red apples.

Fusi even told the big white sheep that he felt scared.
The big white sheep tried different sounds: "Baa—baa! Ah—ah! Ba—la! Fusi, I'm glad you told me this, but I can't change my voice or my size."
The big white sheep trying to make smaller sounds was so funny that Fusi laughed and laughed. Now he felt much safer.

[P10] On the way home, Fusi saw a big red tractor. "Oh! Oh no!" Fusi said.
"Listen to its put-put-put sound," Dad said, "The tractor plows the land, and then the farmer can plant corn."
"Some of the yummy corn is for us to eat, right?" Fusi said, bouncing and jumping. "I get it! The tractor's sound is a good sound. If I don't think it's a bad sound, I won't be scared."
"And also," Dad added, "if you go out to play, after a while you might not even notice these sounds anymore."

[P11] "I don't like the loud barking of the sheepdog," said Fuss, 
"Should I think of that as a friendly sound too?"
"I don't like their barking either," said Dad, "but I tell myself, this special dog makes such a loud noise to keep our flock safe together."
Fuss tried to give those sounds less scary names,
and think of good meanings.
"The tractor's rumbling means we get dinner."
"The sheepdog's barking keeps us safe."
"The big white sheep's call is a friendly hello."
To his surprise, he even began to like some loud sounds.

[P12] But Fuss was still afraid of thunder and lightning.
"We will do our best to protect your safety," Mom said, "so we will tell you, when there is lightning and thunder outside, don't run under the apple tree, and don't play in the river. Remember, Fuss," Mom added, "if there is no rain, we won't have green meadows, no flowers, and no big red apples." 

One afternoon, Dad heard a familiar rumbling sound from afar. He had a good idea to help Fuss.
"Come to the field," Dad said, "The cloud sheep are coming! They are going to the pink and gray cloud castle in the sky to have a concert!"

[P13] The big clouds were getting closer, and yellow lightning occasionally lit up the sky.
"Look! The gray big woolly sheep band is on stage. The trumpets are playing jazz, and the sheep drummer is hitting out a bang-bang—dong-dong—clang sound."
Fus was clinging tightly to his dad.
"I think I saw the big sheep horn," Fus said.
"Yes!" Dad smiled. "Look, the lightning is lighting up the stage, so we can see the band."
The sounds and images of the storm were slowly becoming friendly in Fus's mind. He no longer needed to avoid lightning and dark clouds, because that was the big sheep band's big concert.

[P14] Fus still felt a little afraid, but he had learned to listen to those sounds.
His friends and band sang together, "Baa—baa," "Hum—hum," "Gaa—gaa," "Quack—quack." The rooster and the crow sang together, "Cock-a-doodle-doo—doo—doo," and also "Chirp—chirp—chirp." 
The apple tree's branches and leaves clapped happily, rustling in the wind.
What loud sounds!

[P15] "So much fun!" Fusi said with a smile, clapping his hands and bleating with Dad.
Wow, he also made a big, loud sound!
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《不再害怕 又大又响的东西》，作者为芭芭拉·迈尔，绘者为詹妮弗·坎顿，译者为孙燕。画面描绘了一只小羊在雷雨天气中站在草地上，周围有蓝色雨伞和红色小鸟，背景是乌云和闪电，整体氛围表现了对雷雨等巨大声响的恐惧。
[P2] 本页为绘本《不再害怕又大又响的东西》的封面，展示了书名、作者、绘者、译者及出版社信息，配图是一只小羊站在有花朵和雨伞的草地上，背景为太阳。
[P3] 本页介绍了小羊富丝和他的家人住在农场，他喜欢和朋友们一起玩耍，观察农场里的动物，并聆听周围的声音，如鸭子的嘎嘎声、青蛙的呱呱声、小猪的哼哼声和羊的咩咩声。画面描绘了农场的池塘场景，有鸭子、青蛙、小猪和羊群。
[P4] 本页介绍了小羊富丝害怕一切又大又响的东西，如拖拉机的轰鸣、奶牛的叫声和公鸡的啼鸣，并描述了他面对这些声音时的恐惧反应。
[P5] 本页描述了小羊富丝最害怕雷声，会躲到妈妈肚子下，爸爸注意到他的恐惧后，决定带他去大苹果树边散步，并承诺会一直保护他，帮助他克服害怕。
[P6] 小羊富丝和爸爸在铺满蒲公英的草地上，跟着蜜蜂一起吹蒲公英，富丝感到内心平静，并喜欢和爸爸在一起。
[P7] 小羊富丝在爸爸的鼓励下，面对公鸡的叫声不再害怕，他和乌鸦一起唱歌，感受声音的友好，内心变得平静。
[P8] 小羊富丝和爸爸在苹果树下，看到大奶牛和大白羊，虽然内心害怕，但在爸爸的鼓励下，他克服恐惧，决定留下来，并对自己说爸爸会保护他，他喜欢苹果并期待吃苹果。
[P9] 小羊富丝在爸爸的鼓励下，逐渐克服对大奶牛和大白羊的恐惧，他观察到它们温和友善，最终感到安心，并决定去找大红苹果。
[P10] 小羊富丝在回家路上看到大红拖拉机，起初感到害怕，但在爸爸的解释下，他理解了拖拉机的声音是为种玉米服务的，从而不再害怕，并意识到只要不认为声音是坏的，就不会害怕。爸爸还告诉他，玩得投入时甚至会忽略这些声音。
[P11] 小羊富丝起初害怕牧羊犬的叫声，在爸爸的解释下，他尝试重新理解这些声音，并给它们赋予积极的意义，最终开始喜欢一些原本让他害怕的响声。
[P12] 小羊富丝仍害怕打雷闪电，妈妈解释雨的重要性并给予安全建议；爸爸则听到轰鸣声，想到用‘云朵羊开音乐会’的想象来帮助富丝克服恐惧。
[P13] 小羊富丝在爸爸的陪伴下，将雷雨中的闪电和声音想象成灰色大毛羊乐队的音乐会，逐渐克服了对暴风雨的恐惧。
[P14] 小羊富丝在爸爸的引导下，将雷雨声想象成动物乐队的音乐会，他虽然仍有些害怕，但已学会倾听并欣赏这些声音，感到它们充满欢乐。
[P15] 小羊富丝在爸爸的陪伴下，将雷雨声想象成音乐会，感到非常有趣，开心地和爸爸一起咩咩叫，并发出自己响亮的声音。
[P16] 画面中，一只小羊站在草地上，背景是蓝色的天空、橙色的太阳和几只蝴蝶，旁边还有一朵小花，整体氛围宁静愉快。
